categories.main_business_segments: Fulin Precision Co., Ltd. primarily operates in automotive engine components, new energy vehicle intelligent electronic control components, and lithium-ion battery cathode materials. The company also extends into robotic electric joint modules. Its automotive segment includes precision hydraulic and electromagnetic components for engines and transmissions, as well as smart thermal management and electric drive systems for new energy vehicles. The lithium battery segment focuses on high-density lithium iron phosphate cathode materials for electric vehicles and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced precision manufacturing technologies including deep blind hole processing, laser automatic welding, and high-precision gear shaft manufacturing. It employs a solid-state synthesis process combined with ferrous oxalate for lithium iron phosphate cathode materials, which offers high density, capacity, and long cycle life. The production methods emphasize lean manufacturing, automation, and integrated testing to ensure high quality and cost efficiency. R&D focuses on electric variable valve timing (VVT), intelligent suspension electromagnetic valves, electronic water and oil pumps, and integrated thermal management modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Fulin serves over 60 automotive OEMs including domestic leaders like BYD, SAIC, Geely, Great Wall, Changan, and new energy vehicle startups such as Li Auto, NIO, and XPeng. It also supplies international OEMs including Volkswagen, General Motors, Ford, Toyota, Nissan, and Renault. The lithium battery cathode materials are supplied to major battery manufacturers like CATL. The company’s products are used in passenger vehicles, new energy vehicles, hybrid vehicles, and robotic applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main manufacturing bases in Sichuan Province. It has subsidiaries in Jiangxi, Hunan, Anhui, and Jiangsu provinces. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Europe (France) serving European markets. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 98% of revenue, with growing exports and overseas customer engagements in Europe, North America, India, Southeast Asia, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fulin operates mainly in the midstream segment of the automotive and lithium battery supply chains, manufacturing key components and materials. It produces precision parts for automotive engines and transmissions, smart electronic control modules for new energy vehicles, and cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries. The company is a direct supplier to OEMs and battery manufacturers, integrating upstream raw materials procurement and downstream product assembly and testing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on accelerating the transition to new energy and intelligent automotive components, expanding smart thermal management, electric drive systems, and lithium iron phosphate cathode materials. It emphasizes technology innovation in electric VVT, intelligent suspension valves, high-density cathode materials, and robotic electric joints. R&D investments target product performance enhancement, cost reduction, and expanding applications in new energy vehicles and robotics. The company also pursues strategic partnerships and capital cooperation to strengthen supply chain resilience and market position.
categories.revenue_model: Fulin generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive precision components, new energy vehicle electronic control parts, and lithium battery cathode materials. Sales are mostly conducted via direct contracts with OEMs and battery manufacturers. The company also engages in export sales and some indirect sales through trading companies. Revenue is recognized at the point of delivery and customer acceptance, reflecting product sales rather than subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In automotive engine components, Fulin competes with global suppliers such as INA (Germany), BorgWarner (USA), Eaton (USA), NTN (Japan), Delphi (USA), Denso (Japan), and Hilite (Germany). In new energy vehicle components, it competes with domestic and international suppliers focusing on smart electric drive and thermal management systems. In lithium battery cathode materials, it is a leading domestic player in high-density lithium iron phosphate materials, competing with other Chinese and international cathode material producers. The company positions itself as a technology-driven leader with strong OEM relationships and cost advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Fulin achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.47 billion, a 47% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 397 million, a 173% increase. The lithium battery cathode materials segment accounted for 57% of revenue, growing nearly 72%, while automotive parts contributed 43%. Total assets reached RMB 9.68 billion, with net assets of RMB 4.22 billion. The company has shown strong growth driven by new energy vehicle market expansion and increased production capacity utilization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fulin emphasizes its advanced precision manufacturing capabilities, proprietary cathode material technology with high density and long cycle life, and integrated smart electronic control systems for new energy vehicles. Its products offer high performance, reliability, and cost competitiveness, supported by close collaboration with OEMs for synchronized R&D and rapid response to market needs. The company’s lean management and supply chain integration enable it to deliver high-quality, customized solutions with efficient delivery and competitive pricing, differentiating it in both traditional and emerging automotive and battery markets.
